experiment_template.research_question: Can request-local evidence handles preserve exact delivered-evidence selection while adding zero full read IDs, reducing GLM-5.3-flash terminal-review input by at least 128 tokens, and leaving inherited prompt content exactly paired at 8K?
stop_conditions: Any unbounded unknown usage, retry, asymmetric score, integrity failure, or cost-cap violation stops before the next task.
Stop immediately when six eligible pairs become mathematically unreachable.

records.falsifier: Treatment-added state or schema contains a full read ID; inherited prompt content or mapped-ID counts differ across arms; any handle is ambiguous, invented, or resolves incorrectly; treatment input is not at least 128 tokens lower; any quality metric degrades; aggregate tokens exceed control; or macro Span-F1 gain is below 0.05.
records.mechanism: Partition each first branch request into identical inherited content and registered arm-specific content. Require zero full IDs in treatment-added handle state and schema, exact inherited equality across arms, and deterministic resolution to receipt-bound read IDs before provenance validation.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash fresh scoreable 8K ContextBench development tasks at the 96K cumulative input-plus-output tier.
records.statement: Request-local short handles preserve exact context selection while treatment adds no full read identifiers and inherited full-ID occurrences remain exactly paired.
